import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function to compute the Legendre polynomial
def compute_legendre_plm(l, m, x):
    result = GslSfResult()
    # Ensure x is passed as a ctypes.c_double
    x_c = ctypes.c_double(x)
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_legendre_Plm_e(ctypes.c_int(l), ctypes.c_int(m), x_c, ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError('Error in computation')
    return result.val, result.err

# Define the assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: l=0, m=0, x=0.5
    val, err = compute_legendre_plm(0, 0, 0.5)
    assert abs(val - 1.0) < 1e-10, f"Expected 1.0, got {val}"
    assert abs(err - 0.0) < 1e-10, f"Expected 0.0, got {err}"

    # Test case 2: l=1, m=0, x=0.5
    val, err = compute_legendre_plm(1, 0, 0.5)
    assert abs(val - 0.5) < 1e-10, f"Expected 0.5, got {val}"
    assert abs(err - 0.0) < 1e-10, f"Expected 0.0, got {err}"

    # Test case 3: l=2, m=1, x=0.5
    val, err = compute_legendre_plm(2, 1, 0.5)
    assert abs(val + 1.299038105676658) < 1e-10, f"Expected -1.299038105676658, got {val}"
    assert abs(err - 0.0) < 1e-10, f"Expected 0.0, got {err}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
